data.one_liner: Flutter plugin providing interactive maps, routing, and navigation using Magic Lane SDK
data.what_it_does: It renders high‑performance maps with global coverage, supports turn‑by‑turn navigation, routing, real‑time traffic, and offline use. The SDK exposes a GemMap widget and controller for map interaction.
use_when: Building a navigation app with offline maps
Need real‑time traffic and incident data
Want customizable map styles and 3D terrain
avoid_when: Deploying to production on the web
Using it in a minimal API‑key‑free demo
weaknesses: Web support is alpha and not production ready
Requires an API key and platform‑specific setup
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, set API key via GemMap or GemKit.initialize, add Android Maven repo, set iOS min version 14.0, no extra web config needed

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Google Maps SDK with mature web support

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Open‑source map widget using Leaflet, no API key required
